name: Prefer the least disruptive progression variable
description: Stronger by Science describes progression through reps, load, sets, proximity to failure, and other variables.
explanation: Ordering progression this way changes the least at a time, making it possible to attribute a result to a single variable.

name: Do not increase every variable simultaneously
description: Progressive overload must be based on comparable exercise history and should not simultaneously increase load, reps, and sets without justification.
explanation: Simultaneous multi-variable increases make the plan harder to explain and harder to attribute if something goes wrong.

name: Hold or regress when performance or recovery worsens
description: If performance or recovery worsens, hold load, reduce reps/sets, or substitute as appropriate.
explanation: Progression is not one-directional; regression protects long-term adherence and injury risk.
